entities.summary: The precise date of European discovery is disputed; tradition holds the island was sighted on St. Lucy's Day (December 13), possibly by Juan de la Cosa in 1499 or by Spanish or French navigators. The island appeared on early 16th-century maps but was not settled due to its fierce Kalinago inhabitant
